hypothesis: A clean ablation of the current best recipe's multitask auxiliary heads will reveal whether aux_click_like_forward is carrying real ranking signal or just noise: keep the strongest broad-signal FM+BPR backbone fixed and remove only the auxiliary tasks. Because node 1 scored 0.6046 with aux_click_like_forward while otherwise-similar broad BPR recipes have been near 0.6050 without extras in experience memory, I expect little to no gain and possibly a slight improvement from simplifying the objective.
